icons.subject:
STOMP GLYPH. 24x24logicalgrid,384x384PNG exact16x16blocks, must read as a BOOT STOMP at16px.
ONE CHUNKY TOY BOOT in CLEAN TRUE SIDE VIEW, TOE POINTS RIGHT, heel at LEFT. Classic readable L-SHAPED BOOT: tall RED #d8423c ankle shaft on the left/rear, lower rounded toe projecting to the RIGHT, BRASS #c79a3e thick horizontal SOLE underneath, CLEAR SQUARE HEEL BLOCK and small heel notch. No tilted sole-facing view, no big round rivet, no eye-like buckle, no helmet/hat shape, no bird. Keep red boot upper one large clear shape.
Boot coming STRAIGHT DOWN onto ONE SHORT FLAT NAVY GROUND LINE just below sole. TWO SHORT IMPACT LINES at EACH SIDE of sole, four small strokes total splaying outward. ONE SMALL SHALLOW CURVED SHOCK ARC under the ground line, no full floor circle. Those are small subordinate accents; the side boot must remain large and instantly identifiable. Cream top-left highlight, brass/gold sole, navy outline, red shadow. No leg, wings, clock or other shoe.
